_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: PRUNED AGAINST A LIVE CALENDAR RE-PULLED FOR 2026-08-21 THROUGH 2026-08-27, AND ALL THREE DUTIES ARE RECORDED AS PERFORMED RATHER THAN SKIPPED. NOTHING WAS REMOVED, because nothing on this file has passed: the single NVDA row is dated 2026-08-26 after the close, THREE sessions ahead - 8/24, 8/25, 8/26 - and it was re-verified on this pull as NVDA, 2026-08-26, timing pm, verified true, no actual yet, estimate 2.07 for fiscal Q2 2027. THE CARRIED SPOT WAS REFRESHED FROM A LIVE QUOTE AND THE CORRECTION REPEATED YESTERDAY'S TO THE CENT: 215.01 bid at 19:35:48.690161719Z against the 217.21 written into this file yesterday, a fall of 2.20 or 1.01% in one session - and yesterday's refresh moved the same row 219.41 to 217.21, also exactly 2.20. Two sessions, two identical 2.20 marks lower, 4.40 and 2.01% cumulative. A range implied off the Wednesday figure would now be centred four dollars above the tape, which is the argument for refreshing as a rule rather than when the drift looks large enough to bother with. AMD sat on this board at 522.95 the morning it traded at 486. THE BRANCH CONDITION WAS WIDENED, BECAUSE THE PULL FOUND A PRINT THE ROW DID NOT COVER. MRVL reports 2026-08-27 after the close, verified, estimate 0.87 for fiscal Q2 2027 - a SECOND dated semiconductor print inside the window, one session after NVDA. Branch one was written as 8/25 or 8/26 and would have read as silent on 8/27, so it now names the whole 8/25 to 8/27 stretch. The arithmetic is unchanged and the extra day is not a new judgement; the gap was in the wording, and it was found by re-pulling the calendar rather than by re-reading the file memory of one. CRM, CRWD and SNPS also print 8/26 pm and ADSK, WDAY and ESTC on 8/27, so the back half of next week is dense with software prints as well - none is a watched name and none is entered. IMPLIED MOVE STAYS NULL AND STAYS AN OPEN CHECKLIST ITEM RATHER THAN A PLACEHOLDER TO GUESS AT: no straddle was pulled, this board holds nothing into the print, item 3 is owed only before an earnings hold, and a straddle quoted three sessions early measures a different event than the one that will be priced on 8/26. The 8/25 pre-close owns pulling it if anything is open or contemplated by then, and the 8/27 open owns pruning this row. WHAT THE PULL FOUND ABOUT THE WATCH LIST IS WHAT IT HAS FOUND ALL WEEK: of the watched names NOT ONE has a dated event of its own anywhere in the window - not AS, SMCI, KLAR, SQM, UPST, AMD, IONQ, RGTI, SOUN, OKLO, SMR or JOBY. That is the ninth consecutive session in which a live pull has floored the entire watch list on the catalyst question rather than ranking it. BJ printed this morning at 1.360 actual against a 1.190 estimate, a 14.3% beat, and TGT, SQM, EL, TJX, ADI and ZIM printed 8/19 with WMT, AAP, DE, BABA, NTES, SCSC and ATHM on 8/20 - all of them behind the board rather than ahead of it, and none entered here. THE BOOK IS FLAT INTO THIS ROW AND NO POSITION IS EXPOSED TO IT, which is the outcome the branches below were written six sessions early to produce.

moves.source: Spot REFRESHED LIVE at 19:35:48.690161719Z on 8/21 by the pre-close run, not carried from the day the row was written: 215.01 bid / 215.02 ask on a 0.005% spread, last trade 215.015, against a 216.85 settled close on 8/20 - down 0.85% on the day and DOWN 1.01% from the 217.21 this row carried yesterday. That is a fall of exactly 2.20, the SAME figure as yesterday refresh, which moved this row 219.41 to 217.21. Two consecutive sessions, two identical 2.20 marks lower, 4.40 and 2.01% cumulative - so a row left at the Wednesday figure would now centre its implied range four dollars above the tape. The event was re-verified on a live earnings-calendar pull covering 2026-08-21 to 2026-08-27: NVDA, 2026-08-26, timing pm, verified true, no actual yet, estimate 2.07 for fiscal Q2 2027, THREE sessions ahead. impliedMove is null because NO STRADDLE WAS PULLED - this board holds nothing into the print, item 3 is owed only before an earnings hold, and a straddle quoted three sessions early measures a different event. The 8/25 pre-close owns pulling it if anything is open or contemplated by then. MRVL is recorded here rather than as a second row: it reports 2026-08-27 after the close, verified, estimate 0.87 for fiscal Q2 2027 - a second dated semiconductor print one session behind NVDA, and the reason branch one now spans 8/25 to 8/27 instead of stopping at 8/26. AMD is recorded here as the transmission mechanism rather than as a second row, and its arithmetic is unchanged and still prohibitive: 471.70 bid at 19:35:48.467065832Z, up 0.50% on the session, and one share is 46.74% of a 1009.16 account against the 40% single-name ceiling - WIDER than the 46.2% this row carried yesterday, so AMD is refused by an explicit mechanical limit before any view about NVDA reaches it, and this session made the refusal less marginal rather than more.

branches.cond: An entry considered in the AI or semiconductor complex - AMD, SMCI, MRVL, or any sympathy name - on 8/25, 8/26 or 8/27, into either print
branches.act: Refused, decided now rather than on the day
branches.why: The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print outright, and for equity the -8% stop has to survive the event or it is not a stop. This board has already refused SMCI once on exactly that arithmetic - a 14.4% implied move swallows an 8% stop, so the realistic bad case gaps through the exit rather than filling at it. NVDA own move is not the exposure here; the exposure is that a sympathy name carries the index gap without carrying its liquidity, which is the 2026-08-10 finding about four names off one list being one position at four times the size. THE DATE RANGE WAS WIDENED ON 8/21 AND THE REASON IS RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED OVER. This branch originally read 8/25 or 8/26 and would have been silent on 8/27, when MRVL reports after the close - a second dated semiconductor print the row had not named. The extra day is not a new judgement and changes no arithmetic; the wording was under-inclusive and a live calendar pull found it. Two prints on consecutive evenings also means the complex carries event risk across BOTH nights, so a position opened on 8/26 to trade the NVDA reaction is holding into MRVL, which is the same refusal one day later rather than a clean second entry. Writing the refusal down six sessions early is the point: on 8/26 it would be a view about the report, and today it is a mechanical consequence of a stop that cannot hold.

branches.cond: A position from an unrelated setup is open and running into 8/26
branches.act: The 8/26 pre-close decides it explicitly against this row, and a hold through the print requires the straddle pulled first
branches.why: A name outside the complex is not automatically exposed, and this row must not become a reason to close good positions early on a date that has nothing to do with them. But an NVDA print is the one evening a session where correlation appears in names that showed none for a month, so the hold cannot be passive. Item 3 binds: no straddle pulled means no earnings hold, and that applies to a position held THROUGH the event even when the event belongs to another ticker whose gap it will wear.

branches.cond: The complex sells off into 8/26 and a name on this board looks cheap for it
branches.act: Not bought on that basis, and re-approached only from 8/27 on the reaction bar
branches.why: Cheapness ahead of a dated binary is not a setup - it is the binary being priced, and buying it is taking the event risk the branch above just refused. This is the same reasoning that has kept KLAR unbought through a 22% gap all day: the first print of a fall is not a support level. The post-print session is the first point the rulebook can engage at all, and item 2 then governs - the reaction day is not the entry, the day-2 or day-3 pullback that holds is.
